in_marathi.name: Hareesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hareesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hareesh is a Sanskrit name derived from Hari, the name of Lord Vishnu. It is a revered name in Hinduism and signifies the presence and protection of Lord Hari. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer divine blessings, wisdom, and strength.
